o: In Season 2, the Emberstone has shattered, and it’s a race against the Decepticons to find all the pieces. Limitless power will be at the fingertips of whoever holds the artifact … Amidst the chaos, Robby meets someone special; Mo uncovers an ancient secret in Witwicky; and the Terrans level up. Together the Malto family and the Autobots see how far they must go to defend all that they love.

eps.o: One year later… A new Terran is born!
Mo and Thrash stumble upon ancient ruins and discover a mysterious creature inside.

Hashtag helps the Autobots get rid of all the old GHOST stuff around base, which has her feeling like her GHOST van alt-mode is obsolete, too. Meanwhile, Shockwave needs to acquire a GHOST hard drive that holds a key to Starscream's master plan.
Robby meets his crush, and his siblings feel all his feels at the worst possible time.
Left behind by his siblings, Jawbreaker finds a new friend and sticks close to him.
Twitch welcomes a new Terran to the family…
Spitfire takes from Twitch everything she loves most.
Robby and Hashtag accidentally lose Optimus Prime’s favorite Trailer…
Mo and Hashtag discover Witwicky’s biggest secret, but Starscream knows about it too…
